goal: Deliver a harness-neutral Agent Image v0.1 protocol and toolchain with real Hermes, OpenClaw, DSH, and vHarness adapters; at least three P1 native restores; one Hermes-to-OpenClaw P2 migration; privacy-safe inspect, verify, diff, and redact; a restored trained-agent demonstration; and a third-party-extensible registry.
epoch_goal: Prove Hermes P1 against Hermes Agent v0.20.5 with source immutability, privacy safety, target recognition, and complete loss accounting.

HC-001.rationale: Inspect and reports expose privacy/loss metadata without printing private payloads.

HC-002.rationale: Hermes native state is preserved as a pinned typed opaque layer.

HC-003.rationale: Hermes build and restore reports reconcile all items at their operation boundaries.

HC-004.rationale: The evidence supports only pinned Hermes P1 and explicitly denies P2/P3.

HC-005.rationale: The image preserves multiple persistent state surfaces, but trained-agent semantics remain unproven.

HC-006.rationale: Raw session evidence can be preserved by explicit opt-in without summary substitution.

HC-007.rationale: Behavioral fresh-restore proof remains a later required gate.

HC-008.rationale: Habitat categories remain distinct and unchanged by this adapter epoch.

HC-009.rationale: Skill files and experience/native state are separate, while acquired-skill retention remains unproven.

HO-001.rationale: OCI remains a later transport option.

HO-002.rationale: Hermes behavior is isolated behind the production adapter contract.

HO-003.rationale: License selection remains a release decision.

HO-004.rationale: Context Body and consolidation remain open future mappings.

HO-005.rationale: vHabitat and Team Image remain open future artifacts.

HO-006.rationale: Layer and native filtering provide scoped privacy-stripping evidence.

HO-007.rationale: No contextual attractor claim is encoded or inferred.

content-kernel.purpose: Provide requalified safe archives, manifests, digests, and secret classification.

adapter-runtime.purpose: Own production adapter plans, capabilities, transactions, and reports.

hermes-p1.purpose: Own pinned official Hermes export/import and target invariants.

formal-cli.purpose: Expose production build and restore without fixture capability claims.

interfaces: Core owns .aimg containers and validation; Hermes owns only source/target translation.
Experience and workspace opt-in applies to both logical and native state.
Every portability claim cites the pinned harness and gate evidence.

implementation_noninterference.review_note: The Hermes modules were derived from normative H1-H3/C0/D gates and the pinned official contract; only the separately gated content kernel was reused.

scope_authority.review_note: Formalizing this epoch does not formalize or reject the remaining v0.1 modules and long-horizon options.
